map.之外，剔除变现较慢的存货，看即时偿债能力。: , the quick ratio strips out slower-moving inventory to gauge immediate solvency.
map.存货占比高的企业（如零售、地产），速动比率比流动比率更关键。: For companies with a high inventory share (such as retail and real estate), the quick ratio matters more than the current ratio.
map.债权人审核短期头寸时，速动比率是更严苛的底线指标。: When creditors review short-term positions, the quick ratio is the stricter baseline indicator.
map.某公司流动资产 800 万元（其中存货 300 万元）、流动负债 400 万元，: A company has current assets of 800 (10k CNY) (including inventory of 300 (10k CNY)) and current liabilities of 400 (10k CNY), so the quick ratio = (800−300)/400 = 1.25, meaning quick assets excluding inventory still cover 1.25 times short-term liabilities.
map.通常包括货币资金、交易性金融资产、应收账款等可快速变现资产；保守口径还会剔除变现: They usually include cash, trading financial assets, accounts receivable and other assets that convert to cash quickly; a conservative measure also excludes receivables whose collection is uncertain.
map.速动比率一定要≥1 吗？: Must the quick ratio be at least 1?
map.≥1 表示速动资产足以覆盖短期负债，较安全；但强现金流行业（如快消）可低于 1: A ratio of 1 or more means quick assets cover short-term liabilities and is relatively safe; but strong-cash-flow industries such as FMCG can run below 1 without worry, so judge it together with collection speed.
map.速动比率（本页代码口径）：速动比率=(流动资产−存货)÷流动负债；联动量：流动负: Quick ratio (actual code on this page): quick ratio = (current assets − inventory) ÷ current liabilities; linked values: current liabilities/current assets ratio = current liabilities ÷ current assets, inventory as a share of current assets = inventory ÷ current assets × 100 (%). Validation: all three fields are required and must be valid numbers, otherwise it prompts and stops. Rule: a quick ratio > 1 is graded as meeting the target (>1), and everything else (including exactly 1) as low (<1); the page also performs a gap analysis against a target of 1.0.

Quick ratio (this page's code definition): quick ratio = (current assets − inventory) ÷ current liabilities. Linked values: current liabilities ÷ current assets; inventory as a share of current assets ×100 (%). Validation: all three fields are required finite non-negative numbers; inventory may not exceed current assets; when current liabilities are 0 the ratio shows "Not applicable". Rule: >1 is above the threshold, =1 is at the threshold and <1 is below it; 1.0 is only a reference threshold. Quick assets are simplified as "current assets − inventory" and do not deduct prepayments, deferred expenses or other illiquid items.

map.流动负债为 0 时怎么显示？: How is zero current liabilities shown?
map.分母为 0，速动比率无定义，页面显示不适用；不能把零负债当作达标。: The denominator is 0, so the quick ratio is undefined and the page shows "Not applicable"; zero liabilities must not be treated as meeting the threshold.
